back: A formal, factual document for a specific reader, with findings under headings and recommendations.
Title → To/From/Date → introduction (terms of reference) → procedure → findings → conclusion → recommendations → signature and position.
The statement of what the report investigates, for whom and why.
The facts discovered, stated objectively under headings or numbered points.
Each recommendation must answer a finding.
The purpose of this report is to…; It was found that…; The majority of respondents…; It is recommended that…
Objective, impersonal (passive voice), concise, formal; no story order, no emotional language.
Report: specific reader, headings, objective, recommendations. Article: general readers, headline, lively paragraphs.
